source.stem:
A skydiver jumps from a stationary helicopter and reaches a steady vertical speed. She then opens her parachute.
Which statement about the falling skydiver is correct?

options.text: As her parachute opens, her acceleration is upwards.
As she falls at a steady speed with her parachute open, her weight is zero.
When she accelerates, the resultant force on her is zero.
When she falls at a steady speed, air resistance is zero.

intelligence.enrichment: When an object moves along a straight line, its motion is called linear motion. straight-line path -> linear motion classification The learner correctly applies this rule: When an object moves along a straight line, its motion is called linear motion. Linear motion means any object moving forward or along something that looks ordinary, regardless of the actual path shape.
